broker.name: IC Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2007. Its site names FSA (Seychelles). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:5000.
broker.about: IC Markets says it has operated since 2007. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Raw Spread. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader, IC Social, cTrader Copy, ZuluTrade, MyfxBook, and AutoTrade. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:5000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Raw Trading Ltd, SD018.

plans.name: Standard
plans.billing_note: Zero commission. Spreads from 0.8 pips. Help centre says the spread markup is 0.8 pip above raw interbank prices.

plans.name: Raw Spread
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 0.0 pips. USD 3.50 per lot per side, stated as USD 7.00 round turn. Help centre also says $7 per standard lot round turn.

rows.note: Zero commission. Spreads from 0.8 pips. Help centre says the spread markup is 0.8 pip above raw interbank prices.

rows.label: Raw Spread
rows.note: Spreads from 0.0 pips. USD 3.50 per lot per side, stated as USD 7.00 round turn. Help centre also says $7 per standard lot round turn.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Page says leverage ranges from 1:1 up to 1:5000, and that leverage can be customised subject to risk tolerance and regional eligibility.
Help centre says leverage can be changed in the Client Area. It also describes dynamic leverage that can be lower than the account setting on some instruments.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The same broker publishes two different answers. The forex page FAQ says a minimum deposit of USD 200 gives full market access. The help centre says you can open a trading account without any minimum deposit. The account comparison on the forex page shows a dash for minimum deposit on both account types.

other_fees.label: Funding and withdrawal
other_fees.value: No fees for bank transfers and cards
other_fees.note: The forex page prints an asterisk and does not explain it in the fetched text.

other_fees.label: Inactivity fee
other_fees.note: Help centre says you will not be charged any account inactivity fees.

other_fees.note: Help centre answer on CFD indices.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage and the global regulation page loaded. The regulation page names only the Seychelles FSA licence SD018 for Raw Trading Ltd. The forex page says IC launched in 2007 in Sydney and is regulated across four jurisdictions, but it does not name the other three. Those unnamed regulators are not listed. The forex page mentions claiming a bonus and does not state the bonus amount or terms, so no promotion is recorded. No current headquarters and no company registration number were on the pages fetched.
